name: AI.MD Notes
description: Markdown notes connection type for DBX. Notes are stored as real .md files in the configured directory and exposed through the mdnotes:// virtual filesystem. Includes an AI assistant for analysis, polishing, continuation, and Q&A with OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, or Ollama models.
releaseNotes: The AI assistant now has two modes: Chat for direct conversation and Create for note-aware analysis with insert, replace, append, and copy actions. Model settings now open in a dedicated dialog whose sticky action bar remains visible while scrolling.
